name: Bushcraft crafted items reach the client with a defined subclass (#7188)
contract: Item.dbc gives Crude Waterskin 10521 Consumable subclass 120 and Campsite 1041704 subclass 121; ItemSubClass.dbc
defines neither, and the Bushcraft trade skill window groups its recipes by that subclass.
Learning Crude Waterskin 802808 or Make Camp 804682 streams the crafted item's SMSG_PATCH_ITEM (0x0932) row with
subclass 0 (third field), and the next login streams both rows again without owning either item.
Expected before: no row is streamed, so the client keeps the undefined subclasses.

steps.label: Let the first world entry and its patch stream settle
Learning Crude Waterskin streams its item row
The Crude Waterskin row carries subclass 0
Learning Make Camp streams the Campsite row
Crude Waterskin was not created, so the stream does not depend on owning it
Let the second world entry settle
DISCRIMINATING: the login stream sends the known recipe's Waterskin row again
DISCRIMINATING: the login stream sends the Campsite row again
